subject: Post-call: Private hosting & air-gap constraints — confirmation & workshop
messages:
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medsafe.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 23:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: Private hosting & air-gap constraints — confirmation & workshop

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed set of next steps so we can get the infra workshop scheduled. Please correct anything I missed.

Summary of pain / drivers you called out:
- Regulatory requirement to keep PHI within MedSafe-controlled network (no model traffic egress to public internet).
- Prefer private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with an air-gapped or tightly filtered egress model for telemetry.
- Need KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and audit logs retained for 7 years.
- Tight firewall rules: only allow outbound to a small set of cloud endpoints; prefer explicit allowlist.
- Performance SLOs: 200ms p99 for short queries (<=128 tokens) during business hours; burst capacity for nightly batch jobs.

What we agreed as goals:
1) Validate that Redwood Private can operate in your network constraints without outbound model egress.
2) Define networking allowlist and jumpbox patterns for model serving and management planes.
3) Align on compliance evidence (SOC2, data residency controls) so your audit team is satisfied for procurement.

Outstanding asks from Redwood to prepare the infra workshop:
- MedSafe network diagram (logical + perimeter firewall rules) — ideally at subnet level.
- Contact for your security/infra person who will join the technical workshop.
- Any existing procurement / security questionnaire you want Redwood to fill out before the workshop.

Proposed next steps & timeline:
- Tech workshop with your infra/security + our infra engineers (60–90m). Proposed slots: Wed 3/3 15:00–16:30 PT or Thu 3/4 09:00–10:30 PT.
- We’ll circulate a pre-reads packet (architecture patterns, KMS integration notes, sample allowlist) 24 hours before the workshop.
- After the workshop, we’ll produce a short runbook that maps out network steps and any configuration gaps.

Attachments / pre-reads I’ll send now:
- Redwood private hosting checklist (link in follow-up)

CCing Laura and Marcus from our solutions team — Laura will drive compliance evidence and Marcus will run the technical workshop.

Thanks —
Karhtik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karhtik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medsafe.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <p.nair@medsafe.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 23:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Private hosting & air-gap constraints — confirmation & workshop

Thanks Karhtik — this is accurate and appreciated. A couple clarifications:
- Our primary constraint is no outbound connection from the model-hosting VLAN to any public model endpoints. Management traffic from the admin VLAN may reach specific vendor endpoints if we allowlist them.
- For KMS we will be using our on-prem HSM (Thales) and will require instructions for Redwood to integrate via customer-managed KMS endpoints.
- Audit retention: 7 years preferred but we can discuss rolling windows for higher-frequency events.

I'm attaching the current network diagram (logical) and a short compliance matrix that maps our must-haves.

Attachment: medsafe_network_diagram_v2.pdf (PDF, 842KB)
Attachment: medsafe_compliance_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

Tech workshop attendees from our side: me (SRE), Priya Nair (infoSec), and Rajesh Khalid (network). Priya is best contact for pre-reads.

Both proposed slots look OK on our side — prefer Wed 3/3 15:00 PT. Please send an invite and any pre-reads.

Best,
Sanjay
VP, Platform Engineering
MedSafe Health
mailto:sanjay.patel@medsafe.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medsafe.com>, Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 08:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Private hosting & air-gap constraints — confirmation & workshop

Thanks — placing a few notes from the Redwood infra side to make the workshop efficient: 

Suggested internal attendees (Redwood):
- Marcus Lin (infra lead) — will own the network configuration walk-through
- Priya Shah (runtime eng) — will cover KV cache, batching, and local-only model execution
- Laura Bennett — compliance and evidence pack

Pre-reads I will share by EOD: allowed ports/hosts for management plane, sample jumpbox configuration, and an outline of the customer-managed KMS flow.

Agenda proposal for 60–90m workshop:
1) 10m — goals and current constraints (MedSafe)
2) 25m — detailed network diagram walk (subnets, NAT, DMZ, jumpbox)
3) 20m — KMS/HSM integration approach and audit log flow
4) 15m — performance SLOs, traffic patterns, and burst handling
5) 10m — open Q&A and next steps

If Wed 3/3 15:00 PT is confirmed, I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and an internal pre-call 15m buffer for both teams.

-- Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call: Private hosting & air-gap constraints — confirmation & workshop

Perfect — we’ll lock Wed 3/3 15:00 PT. Invite coming from my calendar in a moment.

Two quick follow-ups so Marcus and Priya Shah can prep: 
- Can you confirm whether the management plane will be allowed to reach vendor update endpoints (yes/no) or if you require offline bundle installs? If offline, we need to size the transfer process and checksum validation.
- For the jumpbox pattern, will you provide NATed egress or explicit allowlist IPs for tools? We prefer a short allowlist for the management plane (we’ll provide the hostnames/IPs in the pre-read).
- Priya (your security contact) — can you share the preferred format for the questionnaire (Doc, Excel, or your ISMS portal link)?

Thanks again — looking forward to the workshop.

Karhtik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
